description: This file declares the 'son_management' class within the 'son' namespace, with static methods to handle CLI and BML messages in the context of the son management component of prplMesh. It includes the 'controller.h' header and uses types from the beerocks and ieee1905_1 namespaces.

classes.name: son_management
classes.description: A class providing static methods for handling CLI and BML messages related to SON (Self-Organizing Network) management tasks.

methods.name: handle_cli_message
methods.description: Handles CLI messages, processing command data received via socket descriptor 'sd', message headers, related protocol message, database, and task pool.

methods.name: handle_bml_message
methods.description: Handles BML protocol messages similarly to CLI, for BML communication in the SON management context.
